commentary_summary: Spot rates on the AG Japan route spiked 19% WoW, reaching $85.1 per tonne, as the tensions in the Persian Gulf escalated. | GPS jamming near Iran and vessel bunching in the Gulf of Oman caused variation in the vessel supply data. | This disruption led to a spike in laden tonnage at anchor across the Indian Ocean. | Meanwhile, tonne-miles index rose 8% WoW, reaching 132.8 points as US LPG exports increased following de-escalation in tariff tensions.
